name: misterplex-multi-pixel-present-contract
description: clk_sys need for 720p content/CEA rasters at 1/2/4 px per clk. Design: .agent-work/w-clock/MULTI_PIXEL_PRESENT_DESIGN.md. Product macro PRESENT_MULTI_PIXEL defaults OFF.

measured_fmax_mhz.source: Plex.sta.rpt Fmax Summary via scripts/check_quartus_timing.py / pll_clock_contract

parent_expectation.note: 2 ppc rescues 720p24 under ship 20 MHz; 2 ppc CEA720p60 still FAILS nostub 32.59 — need 4 ppc.

rtl.cea_h_total_notes: 1650 is EVEN (1650%2=0). 1650%4=2 so PPC=4 needs short final step of 2.
rtl.connection_note: present_core under PRESENT_MULTI_PIXEL: u_mp_timing+beam(H_DE=1280)->ddr PX_PER_CLK->present_npx_path->RGB/CE/H*/V*. Template H_DE=529 untouched when macro OFF. clk_pix=clk until PLL grant.

video_mode_720p.note: Genuine 1280x720 DE under PRESENT_MULTI_PIXEL+use_ext. Same-clock clk_pix=clk_sys=20 MHz cannot hit CEA 24/60 fps; output <=20 Mpix/s regardless of PPC.

w_scaler_interface.h_ownership: w-clock beam owns glass H (+PPC). w-scaler maps glass->store and exports Y qword+1; active 1280 DE with x0%PPC==0 does not straddle for PPC in {2,4}.
